title: My Words Will Never Pass Away

request.style: English, male baritone solo, powerful and reverent, solo, organ, strings, timpani, harp, solemn and majestic, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The fig tree branch grows tender now
And summer near with leaves that grow
So when you see all these things done
Know He is near, just at the door

[Chorus]
Heaven and earth will pass away
But my words will never pass away
Heaven and earth will pass away
But my words will never pass away

[Verse]
This generation will not pass away
Until all these things happen in the day
For in the days of Noah before
People ate and drank, no more

[Chorus]
Heaven and earth will pass away
But my words will never pass away
Heaven and earth will pass away
But my words will never pass away

[Bridge]
Marrying and given in marriage too
Right up to the day the flood broke through
No one knows the day or the hour
Not even angels, not even the power

[Outro]
My words stand firm in the light of day
My words will never pass away
